messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action so that they walk forward, matching the walking motion demonstrated in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's action so that they walk forward, as shown in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands still, then walks slowly forward toward the water's edge, turning their head slightly to the left at the end.","camera":"The camera is positioned behind the subject at a medium distance and slowly dollies forward, tightening into a medium close-up of the upper back.","clothing":"They wear a matching orange, brown, and black plaid two-piece outfit with white cuffs and dark flat shoes.","hair_color":"Dark brown to black.","hairstyle":"Dark hair is pulled back into a high ponytail.","identity":"A person with a slim build is seen from behind, with their face not visible until a brief profile turn near the end.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor stone terrace overlooking a calm sea and rocky shoreline under a clear blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The person now walks forward from the stone terrace toward the water's edge, with a slow forward gait and a slight head turn near the end. The outfit, hairstyle, seaside scene, and overall lighting remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action so they walk forward, matching the reference walking motion, while preserving the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the forward camera tightening is an intended consequence of the walking action or an unintended camera change.
unexpected_changes: The camera framing tightens into a closer upper-body view as the person advances, rather than remaining a fixed medium shot.
